profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
I’m a passionate and all-round Software Engineer with current experience in different Cloud Platform, AWS and Google Cloud, including real time streaming processing.

Experience on Java Core technologies, concurrent programming and multi-threaded applications on the server side, including EAI, Middleware and SOA. Hands-on experience with application server clustered topologies, scalability, high availability and disaster recovery, including performance tuning.

Looking for exciting new opportunities where I can apply and expand my current expertise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working for Ad Platforms Engineering Group.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked in the design and development of the next generation Email Campaign and Trigger Alerts Platform which is composed of a series of micro services on AWS supporting 100+ Millions of consumers.

- Some of the core technologies used are Protocol Buffers for serialization, Apache Kafka as the real time messaging system, Samza over Yarn as our streaming processing framework, including RocksDB as our local db store to maintain local state.

- Additional technologies and tools to support development: Swagger to manage our APIs, Docker to help us with our integration tests, SendGrid as our email delivery solution of choice, DataDog and Sentry for metrics and error monitoring. Gradle/Jenkins/Ansible for builds, continuous integration and deployment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked in different components within the eDiscovery Platform (formerly Clearwell Systems which was acquired by Symantec within my first year in the company), mainly in the back-end side.

- Participated in the design and implementation of multiple features in a java multi-threaded environment, solving common challenges in concurrent programming.

- At the same time I was point of contact for the integration of a third party imaging tool into the platform.

- Some of the technologies and tools used: Java core 6, 7 and 8 through the different product releases. Tomcat and open source database, MySQL together with Hibernate, Lucene, Rest APIs.

- Successfully worked in an Agile/Scrum environment, working closely with Product Managers and Product Owners to understand and translate requirements into product features.

- Closely worked with customers to resolve critical issues in a timely manner what translated in an increase of revenues and customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Clearwell was acquired by Symantec (please check out the description on Symantec entry).

positions.title: WebSphere Process Server Consultant
positions.description:
Solutions Designer and Software Developer,

specialized in EAI, Middleware and SOA. Hands-on experience with application server clustered topologies, scalability, high availability and disaster recovery, including performance tuning.

WebSphere portfolio specialist with emphasis in:

- WebSphere Business Process Management suite (BPM)
- WebSphere Process Server (WPS)
- WebSphere Enterprise Service Bus (WESB)
- Websphere Application Server (WAS)

positions.title: Software Engineer: WebSphere Process Server and BPM Specialist
positions.description:
IT Specialist in Websphere portfolio: BPM Suite (Business Process Management), WPS (WebSphere Process Server), WESB (WebSphere Enterprise Service Bus).

Member of the WebSphere BPM (Business Process Management) SWAT Team that provides technical assistance with customer's highest critical situations worldwide by troubleshooting and solving production and pre-production issues, providing architectural and design advice, system health checks and best practices to customers. 

Other activities included developing PoCs and/or supporting pre-sales as needed, developing articles and conference presentations in order to educate customers worlwide, developing J2EE and BPM applications for internal or customer consumption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in the whole development life cycle (designing, implementing and testing) of a WebSphere Process Server component, the Relationship Service, which supports generic business object mapping for different applications by providing cross referencing for objects represented differently in disparate enterprise applications. Extensive working experience with globally distributed teams, using Eclipse, Rational tools and J2EE technology.
